searches.query: I bought an unused jacket online and it arrived 28 days ago. Can I still start a return, and how soon must I send it after approval?

chunks.text: Standard returns for unused gear  The online store accepts ordinary unused gear within 30 calendar days after delivery. Customers must open a return request in the order portal before that window ends. After approval, they have seven calendar days to hand the parcel to the carrier. The request date determines whether the return was opened on time; the carrier acceptance date determines whether the shipping deadline was met.  Keep the original tags attached and include all parts. Trying a jacket on indoors does not count as using it. Washing a garment, taking a sleeping bag camping, or removing a safety seal does count as use. Used products cannot enter the ordinary change-of-mind return process. Hiking boots have a separate fit-trial policy, and damaged products have a separate warranty process. An exception for one product category does not extend the window for other products in the same order.  The warehouse checks the condition before approving the refund. A return request is not itself a refund.

Returning a gift  A recipient with a gift receipt can return eligible unused gear within 45 calendar days after delivery. The recipient receives store credit equal to the item's paid price. The recipient does not receive a refund to their own bank card. If the purchaser requests the return through their original order, the normal purchaser-refund rules apply instead.  A gift receipt hides the price on the paper presented to the recipient, but the order system still records the actual amount paid. Discounts are included in that amount. For a product bought as part of a discounted bundle, use the bundle-allocation policy to calculate the paid amount for that product. Do not substitute the current shelf price, the pre-discount price, or the price of a replacement item.  Gift returns still require an approved request and must meet the condition requirements. The gift window does not make a used jacket returnable. The return-label fee follows the ordinary return-label policy.

When refunds arrive  The returns team normally inspects an ordinary parcel within five business days after warehouse receipt. Once the return is approved, the store submits the refund within two business days. A bank-card provider may then take another three to five business days to show the credit. These stages happen in sequence. A carrier delivery notification is not the same event as a completed inspection.  For planning, the longest published path is five business days for inspection, two for submission, and five for the card provider: up to 12 business days after warehouse receipt. That is a policy estimate, not a live payment-status lookup. Weekends and published holidays do not count as business days. A missing component or a dispute over condition can require further review.  Gift recipients receiving store credit are sent that credit after approval. The three-to-five-day bank-card processing period does not apply to issuing store credit. This page does not identify whether a particular return has been received, approved, or refunded.

Exchanging a size or color  For a domestic order, an eligible unused product can be exchanged for a different size or color of the same model. The exchange keeps the original paid item price even if the current listing price changed. The replacement must be available when the request is approved. Exchanges into a different model are handled as a return followed by a new purchase at the new model's price.  The warehouse holds an approved replacement for seven calendar days. The customer must hand the returning parcel to the carrier within that period. The hold does not last until the parcel physically arrives at the warehouse. If the dispatch deadline passes, the reservation is released and availability must be checked again. Support cannot promise stock from a catalog description.  Exchanges use the same unused-condition and eligibility-window rules as standard returns. The store does not offer direct international exchanges. An international customer may use the return route if eligible and place a separate new order.

A return request is not itself a refund. Customers receive a receipt after the inspection is complete. Original outbound delivery charges are not refunded for a change of mind. The return-label policy explains who pays for sending an item back. Do not send an item to the warehouse without an approved return request.

Reporting delivery damage or the wrong product  Report visible transport damage or a wrong product within seven calendar days after delivery. Keep the outer packaging and photograph the label, packing materials, and affected item. The support team compares those details with the shipment record before approving the claim. If the item is unsafe to use, stop using it while the report is assessed.  An approved wrong-product or delivery-damage return receives a prepaid label. The customer does not pay the ordinary USD 7 change-of-mind label fee for that approved return. The team confirms whether a replacement or another remedy will be provided. A report being opened does not prove replacement inventory exists or establish a delivery date for the replacement.  Damage involving a rechargeable battery follows the separate damaged-battery procedure. Do not put a leaking or swollen battery in an ordinary return parcel even when support is investigating delivery damage. A manufacturing defect discovered later follows the product's warranty process.

Price adjustments after a purchase  If the store lowers the price of the identical model, size, and color within seven calendar days of an online purchase, the purchaser may request one price adjustment. The lower-priced item must be available to buy when the request is made. A price on another retailer's website does not qualify. A different color or size is not an identical item for this policy.  Final-sale outlet items, bundle promotions, gift-card purchases, and one-use personalized coupons are excluded. The adjustment returns the eligible price difference to the original payment method after approval. It does not change the original order date, extend the return window, or remove a product's shipping restrictions.  Support needs the original purchase record and the current matching listing to decide a live request. These policy documents contain the rule, not today's product prices or inventory. A customer asking for the exact difference on a particular order needs those live values.

The 14-day mismatch report window is a separate route from the manufacturing warranty. Do not describe it as a 14-day change-of-mind return right. Stock for a replacement outlet product is not guaranteed.

An international customer may use the return route if eligible and place a separate new order. Import taxes and international return transport are covered in the international-orders article. Exchange approval does not automatically waive a return-label fee.

answer.answer: Yes, you can still start a return. The online store accepts ordinary unused gear within 30 calendar days after delivery, so you are within the window at 28 days. You must open a return request in the order portal before that 30-day window ends. After approval, you have seven calendar days to hand the parcel to the carrier.
